3. Defendant No. 6, Lutfor Rahman contested the suit claiming only 1.24 acres of S.A. Khatian No. 311 on the allegation that the R.S. recorded tenant Rahimjan made kolraiyati pattan of 1.24 acres of land to Kaisar Ahmed who is the recorded tenant of S.A. Khatian No. 311 and subsequently Kaisar Ahmed sold the land to Defendant No. 6. None of the defendants except Defendant No. 6 denied the title and possession of the plaintiffs. The further contention of Defendant No. 6 is that Tajumuddin had 1/3rd share in the suit property who died leaving a son Panjat Ali and daughter Pearjan; that Panjat Ali died leaving a sister Pearjan as his sole heir, Nizamuddin and Ahmed All had 2/3rd shares in the Khatian as per C.S. Khatian; that Nizamuddin died leaving two sons Aptar Ali and Amzad Ali and Amzad All died leaving behind three sons, three daughters and a wife, Ahmed Ali Heba gifted the entire share to Panjat Ali; that Pearjan and the heirs of Amjad Ali settled 1.23 acres of land with one Rahimjan in 1316 B.S. at a jama of Tk. 16/- and Rahimjan had been in possession of the suit land since her pattan. Rahimjan again settled 1.40 acres of land to Kaisar Ahmed by registered patta dated 10th Baisakh, 1352 B.S. and 1.24 acres of land stood recorded in the name of Kaisar Ahmed correctly that while in possession in that land Kaisar Ahmed sold his land to Defendant No. 6 by a kabala dated 27th Aswin, 1374 B.S. and Defendant No. 6 have been possessing the same since then. The plaintiffs filed a Partition suit being T.S. No. 184 of 1960 which was dis-missed; that thereafter another T.S. No. 207 of 1979 was filed which was also dis-missed. The present suit has also been brought on some false allegations and the suit is liable to be dismissed. 

 9. The defendant alleged riyati patta by heirs of Amjad Ali, the successor-in-interest of Nazimuddin alleging pattan of 1.24 decimals dated 23.4.1945 corresponding to 1360 B.S. at a jama of Tk. 16/- in favour of Rahimjan, who while in possession settled 1.40 acres to Kaiser Ahmed by patta of dated 10th Baishak 1352 B.S. in whose name S.A. Khatian No. 311 was recorded who in his turn while in possession sold 1.24 decimal by kabala dated 27th Aswin 1374 B.S. Ext. C in favour of Defendant No. 6 who has been possessing. 

 10. From the above, it appears Rahimjan obtained pattan from the heirs of Amjad Ali but no patta or any rent receipt showing the settlement has been produced in the suit. D.W. 1 has simply stated that the heirs of Amjad Ali patta settled to Rahimjan in 1360 B.S. by Dhakhila for 1.24 acres at a jama of Tk. 16/- but no patta or rent receipt has been produced.
